***Bloodgruel***: The target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
***Spinemarrow***: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

This unit’s cauldron is either **filled with grisly remains** or **empty**. It starts the battle **empty**. If an enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn is destroyed and this unit’s cauldron is **empty**, it becomes **filled with grisly remains**.

Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle. You cannot pick an effect that has already been picked for another friendly **Tyrant**.

• ***Neck-wringer***: Enemy **INFANTRY** units that have a Health characteristic of 1 or 2 cannot contest objectives while they are in combat with this unit.

• ***Steed-eater***: Enemy **CAVALRY** units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

• ***Giant-wrestler***: Enemy **MONSTERS** cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
